The /organizations/support/tickets/list API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

SupportTicketListResponse Model - Response from listing the support tickets of an organization.
open SupportTicket Array
Open tickets of the organization.
closed SupportTicket Array
Closed tickets in the requested page.
closedPage integer
Index of the page of closed tickets in the response.
totalClosed integer
Number of closed tickets of the organization.
allowance integer
Number of tickets your support seat lets you open in a 1-month rolling window.
remaining integer
Number of new tickets you can open now. The value is the allowance minus the tickets you opened in the last month, including closed tickets.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
Example 
{
  "open": [
    {
      "hash": "string",
      "title": "string",
      "status": "Open",
      "time": "September 29, 2026 - 18:00",
      "timeUnix": 0,

SupportTicket Model - A support ticket of an organization.
hash string
Id of the ticket.
title string
Subject of the ticket.
status string Enum
Status of the ticket. Options : ['Open', 'Closed']
time string
example: September 29, 2026 - 18:00
Time of the last update of the ticket.
timeUnix integer
Unix timestamp of the last update of the ticket.
data SupportTicketData object
Details of a support ticket.
profiles SupportTicketMember Array
Members who took part in the ticket.
Example 
{
  "hash": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": "Open",
  "time": "September 29, 2026 - 18:00",
  "timeUnix": 0,
  "data": {
    "external_id": "215476157330380",
    "ticket_hash": "string",
    "status": "open",
    "subject": "string",
    "created_time": "2026-09-29 18:00:38",
    "updated_time": "2026-09-29 18:01:28",
    "project_id": 0,
    "backtest_id": "string",
    "live_deploy_id": "string"
  },
  "profiles": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "profile": "string"
    }
  ]
}
SupportTicketData Model - Details of a support ticket.
external_id string
example: 215476157330380
Id of the ticket in the QuantConnect support system. Mention this Id when you contact our Support Team about the ticket.
ticket_hash string
Id of the ticket in the API. The value is the same as the hash of the ticket.
status string Enum
Status of the ticket. Options : ['open', 'closed']
subject string
Subject of the ticket.
created_time string
example: 2026-09-29 18:00:38
Time the ticket was opened, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
updated_time string
example: 2026-09-29 18:01:28
Time of the last update of the ticket, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
project_id integer
Id of the project attached to the ticket.
backtest_id string
Id of the backtest attached to the ticket.
live_deploy_id string
Id of the live deployment attached to the ticket.
Example 
{
  "external_id": "215476157330380",
  "ticket_hash": "string",
  "status": "open",
  "subject": "string",
  "created_time": "2026-09-29 18:00:38",
  "updated_time": "2026-09-29 18:01:28",
  "project_id": 0,
  "backtest_id": "string",
  "live_deploy_id": "string"
}
SupportTicketMember Model - A member who took part in a support ticket.
name string
Name of the member.
profile string
URL of the profile image of the member.
Example 
{
  "name": "string",
  "profile": "string"
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
